preconditions.expression: T == int(stdin.split()[0]) and T >= 1 and T <= 1000
preconditions.description: T is the number of test cases, where 1 ≤ T ≤ 1000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= N <= 10**5 for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:] if line.strip() and (N := int(line.split()[0])) is not None)
preconditions.description: For each test case, N is the number of days, where 1 ≤ N ≤ 10^5.

preconditions.expression: all(2 <= K <= 10**5 for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:] if line.strip() and (K := int(line.split()[1])) is not None)
preconditions.description: For each test case, K is the number of places, where 2 ≤ K ≤ 10^5.

preconditions.expression: all(len(A) == N for A in [list(map(int, line.split())) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:] if line.strip() and len(line.split()) == N])
preconditions.description: For each test case, the sequence A has exactly N elements.

preconditions.expression: all(Ai in {*range(1, K+1), -1} for A in [list(map(int, line.split())) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:] if line.strip()] for Ai in A)
preconditions.description: Each element in A is either -1 or a place number between 1 and K (inclusive).

preconditions.expression: all(Ai != Aj for i, Ai in enumerate(A) for j, Aj in enumerate(A) if i < j < len(A) and Ai != -1 and Aj != -1 and j == i + 1)
preconditions.description: If two consecutive days have non-decided places (A_i ≠ -1 and A_{i+1} ≠ -1), they must not be the same place.

postconditions.expression: all(stdout_line.strip() in ['YES', 'NO'] for stdout_line in stdout.splitlines() if stdout_line.strip())
postconditions.description: For each test case, the first line of output is either 'YES' or 'NO'.

postconditions.expression: all(len(output_sequence) == N for output_sequence in [list(map(int, line.split())) for line in stdout.splitlines()[1::2] if line.strip()])
postconditions.description: If the answer is 'YES', the second line contains exactly N space-separated integers.

postconditions.expression: all(Ai in {*range(1, K+1)} for A in [list(map(int, line.split())) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:] if line.strip()] for Ai in A if Ai != -1) and all(Ai in {*range(1, K+1)} for output_sequence in [list(map(int, line.split())) for line in stdout.splitlines()[1::2] if line.strip()] for Ai in output_sequence)
postconditions.description: All non-decided places in the input and all places in the output sequence are valid place numbers between 1 and K (inclusive).

postconditions.expression: all(Ai != Aj for i, Ai in enumerate(output_sequence) for j, Aj in enumerate(output_sequence) if i < j < len(output_sequence) and j == i + 1)
postconditions.description: In the output sequence, no two consecutive days have the same place.

postconditions.expression: all(Ai == Bi for i, Ai in enumerate(A) for Bi in output_sequence if Ai != -1)
postconditions.description: The output sequence respects the original non-decided places (A_i ≠ -1 implies A_i == output_sequence[i]).

postconditions.expression: all('YES' in stdout.splitlines()[i] for i in range(0, len(stdout.splitlines()), 2) if any(Ai == -1 for Ai in A)) or all('NO' in stdout.splitlines()[i] for i in range(0, len(stdout.splitlines()), 2) if all(Ai != -1 for Ai in A))
postconditions.description: If there are no undecided places (all A_i ≠ -1), the answer must be 'YES' if the sequence already satisfies the consecutive place condition, otherwise 'NO'.
